test_BnbQuantizationConfig_validation: test that BnbQuantizationConfig raises ValueError when both load_in_8bit and load_in_4bit are set to True
test_8bit_quantization_empty_model: test 8-bit quantization of a Bloom model loaded from empty weights using init_empty_weights and load_and_quantize_model
test_4bit_quantization_empty_model: test 4-bit quantization of a Bloom model loaded from empty weights using BnbQuantizationConfig with load_in_4bit
test_quantized_model_memory_footprint: test that an 8-bit or 4-bit quantized model has a smaller memory footprint than its fp16 counterpart
test_quantized_model_serialization: test saving and reloading an 8-bit quantized model with sharded state dict using accelerate save_model
